title: Site Heat Scorecard
one_liner: Score candidate data center sites for local political and permitting risk, then export a one-page memo.
headline: Score your candidate data-center sites for political and permitting risk, reweight the factors live, and export a one-page memo.

episode.title: The Great Collision Between Politics and AI | #309

history.summary: A tightly scoped, well-coded tool: a single FACTORS array drives the score, the per-factor reasons, and the weight sliders, so the weighted 0–100 heat score is genuinely transparent and instantly reactive. All three podcast figures match the verified IDEA.json figures and are clearly attributed as podcast context, not score inputs; example sites and example talking points are honestly labelled, and the optional BYOK talking-points flow fails gracefully to a labelled example on error. Minor polish items remain (a past-due vote date scores as if imminent, no formula note next to the weights) but nothing blocks publishing.
